Credit-claiming = claiming responsibility for desirable governmental outcomes (especially particularized benefits: pork, grants, earmarks, casework) or general policies where the actor claims to have made a difference. Position-taking = stating positions on issues (speeches, roll calls) without claiming to have produced outcomes.
